git.baseMeaning: Git base at local capture; the selected uncommitted source snapshot is identified by the file hashes. Subsequent commit identity and CI results are authoritative on the dedicated GitHub branch/PR.

candidateEvidence.scopeMeaning: Source snapshot after the product HIS metadata repair, OpenAPI Unicode export correction and five formatting-only EOF removals. Previous full G4/images/browser are historical; current focused proofs and remote CI are separate authorities.
candidateEvidence.globalGateMeaning: This manifest identifies raw sources, not a successful commit, whole G4, image, browser run or hospital acceptance.

scope.rootConfigurationPolicy: Explicit package/lock/environment example/ignore/node-version files; root Dockerfile*, docker-compose*.yml|yaml, *.config.* and tsconfig*.json.
scope.testInputPolicy: Include nonignored tests/ validation inputs, including browser tests and versioned visual baselines; PostgreSQL and unit test inputs under src/ are already covered. Runtime datasets and generated test-results/playwright-report remain excluded.
scope.planningAndReportingPolicy: Documentation is restricted to the eight exact normative paths in normativeDocs. Planning docs, build/audit reports, temporary evidence and this manifest/script are outside the fingerprint to avoid self-reference.
scope.dockerfilePolicy: All nonignored repository-relative regular files whose basename begins with Dockerfile.
scope.deploymentPolicy: Include the nonignored deploy scripts/configuration, including release guards, backup/WAL/offsite, local bootstrap/scanner, MinIO IAM, Caddy, firewall example and observability configuration. rclone.conf.example contains only explicit CHANGE_ME placeholders; real rclone.conf is excluded even if tracked or not ignored.
scope.gitSelection: Union of git ls-files --cached --others --exclude-standard, deduplicated; git check-ignore --no-index --stdin -z removes ignored tracked or untracked paths before the explicit scope and exclusions are applied.
exclusions: No real .env files; only the three exact root example templates are eligible.

No data, builds, artifacts, logs, secret directories, credential filenames/configuration or secret-container/key/certificate file types. The exact two normative docs/build JSON files are included as requested.
No symlink files or files with symlink ancestors; only regular repository-relative files are read.
No external repository, runtime database, environment content, network lookup, container inspection or credential access.
notClaimed: This scope does not include mutable data or generated build output.
It does not include all documentation or browser reports, and does not represent a committed tree.
scope.auxiliaryPublicationMeaning: Exact CSV whitespace attributes are recorded separately; they do not change runtime sources or spreadsheet bytes and are outside the existing source fingerprint selector.

algorithm.fileHash: SHA-256 over exact raw file bytes.
algorithm.ordering: Unique repository-relative POSIX paths, sorted ascending by Unicode code point.
algorithm.canonicalRepresentation: UTF-8 encoding of JSON files array with each record ordered as path then sha256, ensure_ascii=False, compact separators comma/colon, followed by exactly one LF byte. Metadata is not part of the fingerprint.

snapshotApplicability.meaning: Original fields and results are preserved at their captured inputs. Only analytics test clock and CI duration change in the subsequent candidate; unchanged HIS focused proofs retain their scopes.
